Block 2 — I/O memory map (critical for verifying DTS addresses):
echo "=== iomem ===" && cat /proc/iomem

Block 3 — Interrupts (verify GIC wiring):

---
Block 4 — Loaded modules (shows what drivers Android uses):
echo "=== modules ===" && lsmod
echo "=== modfiles ===" && find /lib/modules -name "*.ko" 2>/dev/null | sort

---
Block 5 — Block / storage devices:
echo "=== partitions ===" && cat /proc/partitions
echo "=== mounts ===" && cat /proc/mounts
echo "=== blkid ===" && blkid 2>/dev/null || true

---
Block 6 — USB and network:
echo "=== net ===" && ip link show 2>/dev/null || ifconfig -
echo "=== usb devices ===" && ls /sys/bus/usb/devices/ && cant 2>/dev/null | grep -E "DRIVER|PRODUCT|DEVTYPE"
echo "=== platform devs ===" && ls /sys/bus/platform/devices
